dog.description_text: Meet Chili — New Arrival! Chili just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FChili%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQrJ%5Fu1pLutHQLPJtLHwmkCvEgUD0DiqSIspkkKjowyIhY7MRg His foster says "At 48 hours, Chili had already settled right in — he started playing ball the moment he arrived, before even exploring the house. He's very, very sweet with everyone — people, dogs, and children — and not reactive at all. He loves playing ball and walks beautifully on leash. Chili is such an easy-to-please little dog — just give him a ball and he's happy with everything." He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
